words.note: 最直接、最常見的核心近義詞之一。通常指一次具體手術事件，語氣比研究型術語更日常。

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近。operation 通常指一次具體手術事件；surgery 也可表示整個手術治療方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She had an operation yesterday. Surgery may be considered if other treatments fail.

falseSynonyms.zh: medical procedure 更廣，可以是非手術性的檢查／介入；不是所有 medical procedures 都是 surgery。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An endoscopy is a medical procedure. The patient required surgery to repair the tendon.

falseSynonyms.zh: surgical procedure 更正式、技術化，常在知情同意、病歷或研究中使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The surgeon explained the surgical procedure. The patient is recovering from surgery.

falseSynonyms.zh: surgical treatment 強調手術作為治療策略，常與 conservative/non-surgical treatment 對比。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The condition may require surgical treatment. The operation lasted two hours.

falseSynonyms.zh: surgical intervention 是更正式的研究／指引用語，把手術視為介入措施。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The guideline recommends surgical intervention in severe cases. She had surgery last week.

falseSynonyms.zh: surgical management 範圍更廣，可包括術前評估、手術決策與術後跟進。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The patient was referred for surgical management. The operation itself took ninety minutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: therapy 是治療的廣義詞，通常不特指手術。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is receiving physical therapy. She underwent surgery.

falseSynonyms.zh: surgery 是手術／外科；surgeon 是外科醫生，指稱和詞類都不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The surgeon explained the risks. The surgery was successful.
